customManagers.description: Pinned tool versions: a `# renovate:` comment directly above `ARG <NAME>_VERSION=<value>`. FROM is left to the built-in dockerfile manager.

packageRules.description: Automerge relies on a required status check on the build job; the owner enables branch protection later. platformAutomerge stays off until then, so Renovate itself waits for the PR's checks instead of GitHub merging an unprotected branch at once.
Keep the Debian FROM and the Dockerfile syntax frontend pinned by digest.
Wait three days after publication before taking a registry release that has a native release timestamp.
Stay on the Node 24 LTS line.
Stay on the TypeScript 6 line; the language server resolves the global typescript as its sibling.
